name: Beale AFB
description: Home of the 9th Reconnaissance Wing. Beale AFB operates U-2 Dragon Lady and RQ-4 Global Hawk intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions, providing critical ISR support worldwide.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: Bishops Pumpkin Farm
events.description: Bishops Pumpkin Farm Oct 10, 10 am–4 pm Cost: $35 Sign-up Deadline: Oct 6 Beale ODR Celebrate the fall season with a trip to Bishop’s Pumpkin Farm! Enjoy hayrides, a corn maze, farm attractions, seasonal treats, and plenty of time to explore. Whether you’re picking the perfect pumpkin or making memories with family and friends, this festive day trip is the perfect way to welcome autumn. We will provide admission for the Corn Maze, Golden Grain Raceway, Train Ride and a voucher for a cup of cookies.

events.title: Fall Bazaar
events.description: Fall Bazaar October 16, 4-6pm Ryden Park Join us for a fantastic autumn day packed with excitement for the whole family! Bring your friends, family, and fall spirit—we can’t wait to see you there! 🍁✨ Here is what you can look forward to: 🚀 Euro Bungee Bounce: Soar to new heights and flip for fun! 🎟️ Carnival Games: Test your skills and win awesome prizes! 🛍️ Local Booths: Shop unique crafts, delicious treats, and local vendor goods! Trunk or Treat brought to you by Beale AFB Homes. Sign up below. Award will be given to the best decorated car! https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0F44A5AB23AAFDC2

events.title: Coldstream Canyon Fall Colors Hike
events.description: Coldstream Canyon Fall Colors Hike October 17, 8am-4pm $35 Sign-Up Deadline: Oct 13 Beale ODR Enjoy a scenic fall hike through Coldstream Canyon near Donner Memorial State Park, following the canyon through pine forest, along Coldstream Creek, and past ponds surrounded by colorful aspens and cottonwoods. The trail offers a peaceful alpine setting with views of the surrounding Sierra ridges and plenty of opportunities to enjoy the vibrant gold, yellow, and orange fall foliage. * Mileage: 4.6 miles * Elevation Gain: 734 ft * Difficulty: Moderate

events.title: Trick or Treat Week!

Whether it’s spooky, silly, magical, or inspired by your favorite character, stop by the library to show off your look. As a special treat, costumed visitors will receive a delicious Rice Krispy Treat (while supplies last!)

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Gold Country Inn (530-634-2953) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (530-634-2794) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 9 FSS, M&FRC, and official Beale sites for in-processing and ISR mission support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
